Every other host tried by direct fetch -- openai.com, blog.google, ai.meta.com, x.ai, mistral.ai, api-docs.deepseek.com, news.ycombinator.com, hn.algolia.com, news.smol.ai, thursdai.news, www.nocode.mba, www.youtube.com, www.oneusefulthing.org, www.latent.space, lesswrong.com, www.theregister.com -- returned DNS/egress-proxy ENOTFOUND. That is far more than 1/3 of configured sources blocked for direct access; WebSearch remained the only reliable discovery/verification channel for blocked hosts, and its index lags live content by 1-2 days, which is why the AI Explained video (Nov 19) just missed the 7-day expert window and why Claude Ship/EFS (both Nov 23 on claude.com) had apparently been missed by the runs on Nov 24-26 -- claude.com/blog does not appear to have been checked on those days (no corresponding run_log source entries), so these two were effectively a backlog catch-up rather than same-day news. Expert-content minimum (5) was not met (0 published) for the fourth day running: all 5 configured video experts are YouTube-hosted and unreachable directly, and the 3 configured/substitute article experts (Simon Willison, Latent Space, Ethan Mollick) had no unpublished post inside their 7-day freshness window. No news or quotes were invented; a couple of unverifiable leads (Zvi 'AI #195', aiweekly.co's recirculated Rust-rewrite/sandbox-escape mentions) were deliberately left out rather than risk stale or fabricated attribution.
